answer.summary: The API never came up: the health check on /api/me timed out after 300s (last HTTP 000) right after Spring Boot logged a startup failure. The migrations before it ran cleanly, but the actual failure reason is cut off in the excerpt, so this is not certain. Because it is a deterministic startup failure on a PR that changes Spring services, treat it as likely caused by the change until the root cause in the full log is confirmed.
